RTL-SDR Blog V4 R828D RTL2832U 1PPM TCXO SMA Software Defined Radio Dongle + Antenna kit

->RTL-SDR Blog V4 with upgraded R828D tuner & 1 PPM TCXO
->Built-in HF upconverter for improved signal reception
->Bias tee circuit & notch filter for reduced interference

-Wide frequency range: 500 kHz to 1.766 GHz (no gaps)
-High-accuracy 1 PPM TCXO for stable tuning
-Based on RTL2832U chipset and R828D tuner
-Aluminum enclosure for enhanced shielding and durability
-Direct sampling mode for HF (500 kHz – 30 MHz) reception
-Compatible with popular SDR software (SDR#, HDSDR, CubicSDR, etc.)
-Bias-T power output for active antennas and LNAs
-USB-powered and plug-and-play support
-Compact and portable design
